acquisition method: Protein quantification was performed using Vanquish UHPLC (Thermo Fisher Scientific) and TSQ-Vantage EMR (Thermo Fisher Scientific) with a HESI-II ion source (Thermo Fisher Scientific) in multiple reaction monitoring (MRM) mode.
alkylation reagent: Ten microliters of supernatant was reduced by dithiothreitol, alkylated with iodoacetamide, and digested with trypsin/Lys-C mix (Promega) in 50 mM ammonium bicarbonate (pH 8.0) (Sigma) at 37 °C overnight.
cleavage agent: Ten microliters of supernatant was reduced by dithiothreitol, alkylated with iodoacetamide, and digested with trypsin/Lys-C mix (Promega) in 50 mM ammonium bicarbonate (pH 8.0) (Sigma) at 37 °C overnight.
instrument: The trypsinized sample was applied to an EASY-nLC 1000 liquid chromatograph (Thermo Fisher Scientific) and Q-Exactive mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific) equipped with a nanospray ion source (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
ionization type: The trypsinized sample was applied to an EASY-nLC 1000 liquid chromatograph (Thermo Fisher Scientific) and Q-Exactive mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific) equipped with a nanospray ion source (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
labeling: For protein quantification analysis by LC–MS/MS, 10 pmol of stable isotope–labeled peptides (synthesized by the Support Unit for Bio-Material Analysis, RIKEN Center for Brain Science) were added to the digested sample as an internal standard.
precursor tolerance: peptide mass tolerance, 6 ppm; fragment mass tolerance, 20 mmu
fragment tolerance: peptide mass tolerance, 6 ppm; fragment mass tolerance, 20 mmu
ptm: fixed modifications, carbamidomethyl (Cys); variable modifications, oxidation (Met)
